golan-levin--messa-di-voce-installation.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪定位每位观众头部和嘴部的位置，实时音频分析（振幅、音高、频谱特征）生成从该点发出的投影图形，这些图形随后与身体剪影发生碰撞。
golan-levin--messa-di-voce-installation.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe to find the mouth, analyze volume and pitch with p5.sound, and blow bubbles of different shapes out of the mouth, projected on a wall. Twist: design one shape for each vowel (a, e, i, o, u) and have everyone 'write' with their voice.

msr-benko-wilson--playanywhere.description_zh: Andy Wilson 设计的紧凑型前投式桌面系统：小推车上的投影仪和摄像头能把任何一张桌子变成可感知触摸和物体的表面，用于玩游戏、看地图和分享照片。
msr-benko-wilson--playanywhere.idea_en: A projector and camera on a small cart turn any table into a touch-enabled game table.
msr-benko-wilson--playanywhere.technique_zh: 短焦投影仪加上带红外照明的红外摄像头，通过分析阴影和接触来感知手指触摸，并利用视觉编码和光流检测普通桌面上的物体和纸张。
msr-benko-wilson--playanywhere.exercise_en: Mount a small projector and a phone camera on a stand looking down at a table, judge a 'touch' from the distance between a finger and its shadow, and build a projected jigsaw puzzle or draggable map. Twist: make real objects on the table (cups, keys) act as obstacles in the game.

golan-levin--scrapple.description_zh: 摆在桌上的日常物品被读作一份实时乐谱上的音符；扫描桌面时把它们演奏成声音，同时投影为这些物品叠加上图形。
golan-levin--scrapple.idea_en: Whatever you toss on the table becomes a score that plays live and gets marked up by projection.
golan-levin--scrapple.technique_zh: 俯拍摄像头分割桌上的物体（背景减除加色块检测），像频谱图乐谱一样把横轴当作时间、纵轴当作音高，一条扫描的播放头把色块转成声音，投影则将它们高亮显示。
golan-levin--scrapple.exercise_en: Film the table from above, detect object blobs in p5.js with the horizontal axis as time and the vertical axis as pitch, and play and highlight them by projection as a playhead sweeps across. Twist: compose using only kitchen items and play the class a 30-second 'breakfast tune'.

scott-snibbe--shadow-bag.description_zh: 投影仪捕捉观众的影子，再以难以预料的变化重新投射出来：有时是真实的影子，有时是一个脱离身体的副本，朝观众跑来或从观众身边跑开。
scott-snibbe--shadow-bag.idea_en: Your shadow stops obeying: sometimes it follows you, sometimes it walks off on its own.
scott-snibbe--shadow-bag.technique_zh: 摄像头的剪影缓冲按每次互动随机选取的变换（延迟、偏移、缩放、方向）进行回放。
scott-snibbe--shadow-bag.exercise_en: Build a shadow projection program that randomly switches among four modes: normal, delayed, mirrored and running away. Twist: have classmates guess which rule is active.

rafael-lozano-hemmer--subtitled-public.description_zh: 在一个空房间里，监控系统检测到每位来访者，并在他们胸前投射一个随机的第三人称动词；想摆脱自己的词，唯一的办法是触碰别人，由对方接过去。
rafael-lozano-hemmer--subtitled-public.idea_en: Everyone gets a verb label projected on their body, and the only way to pass it on is to touch someone else.
rafael-lozano-hemmer--subtitled-public.technique_zh: 俯拍摄像头追踪每个人，引导文字投影落在其身体上，当两个被追踪的色块相互接触时交换标签。
rafael-lozano-hemmer--subtitled-public.exercise_en: Track classmates with an overhead camera and project a word onto each person, swapping words when two people touch. Twist: replace the words with adjectives the classmates wrote themselves, and watch how the labels flow.

blair-macintyre--voices-of-oakland.description_zh: 在亚特兰大历史悠久的奥克兰公墓进行的音频 AR 徒步导览，由演员演绎的逝者之声在各自墓前讲述他们的故事。
blair-macintyre--voices-of-oakland.idea_en: Walk into a cemetery and hear the people buried there tell their own stories at their graves.
blair-macintyre--voices-of-oakland.technique_zh: 由 GPS 位置触发基于地点的音频片段，叙事被组织为一段互动导览，用户在每座墓前选择要收听哪条故事分支。
blair-macintyre--voices-of-oakland.exercise_en: Use a phone web page and the Geolocation API to set up four geofences on campus, so that arriving at a spot automatically plays a classmate's recording of 'a story that happened here'. Twist: the content branches depending on the direction you came from or how long you stay.

rafael-lozano-hemmer--under-scan.description_zh: 城镇广场被白光笼罩；行人走过时，当地人的视频肖像会出现在他们的影子里，抬头看着他们，人一离开就消失不见。
rafael-lozano-hemmer--under-scan.idea_en: Walk across the square and a stranger appears in your shadow, looking up at you.
rafael-lozano-hemmer--under-scan.technique_zh: 计算机视觉从上方追踪行人并预测其路径，使投影仪能提前一刻把视频肖像精确地投进每个人的影子里。
rafael-lozano-hemmer--under-scan.exercise_en: Project white light onto the ground, use a camera to find where shadows are, and project classmates' pre-recorded 'looking up' videos inside them. Twist: the longer a shadow stays, the longer the sentence the person in the video speaks.

scott-snibbe--visceral-cinema-chien.description_zh: 投影播放布努埃尔和达利的《一条安达鲁狗》（Un Chien Andalou）片段；观众的影子走进电影，取代了拖着三角钢琴的那个角色。
scott-snibbe--visceral-cinema-chien.idea_en: Visitors' shadows walk into a surrealist film and take over the lead role.
scott-snibbe--visceral-cinema-chien.technique_zh: 把摄像头实时捕捉的剪影合成进预先分割好的电影画面中，让影子触发并推动场景中的关键时刻。
scott-snibbe--visceral-cinema-chien.exercise_en: Pick a classic film clip, use camera silhouettes to 'put' classmates into the frame and trigger the next shot. Twist: the scene continues only when a shadow strikes the same pose as the original character.

klaus-obermaier--apparition.description_zh: 两位舞者在互动投影中表演，投影根据他们的动作实时生成，既投在背景上，也直接投在他们的身体上。
klaus-obermaier--apparition.idea_en: Dancers' moves generate projections live on the backdrop and on their bodies, so body and image pull on each other.
klaus-obermaier--apparition.technique_zh: 红外摄像头追踪提取舞者的剪影和动作，输入基于物理的生成式视觉系统，再实时投射回表演者身上和屏幕上。
klaus-obermaier--apparition.exercise_en: Extract a dancer's outline with a camera and use it to drive particles or a spring mesh projected back onto the dancer in real time. Twist: make the image 'reject' the dancer, with patterns fleeing outward as the outline approaches.

scott-snibbe--cause-and-effect.description_zh: 观众的剪影在撞上此前观众的影子录像时被记录下来；回放时只显示录下的动作，因此那些反应看起来像是自发的手势。
scott-snibbe--cause-and-effect.idea_en: Your movements are recorded and jostle with the shadows of earlier visitors, forming a chain of cause and effect across time.
scott-snibbe--cause-and-effect.technique_zh: 摄像头录下的剪影片段放在可滑动的格子上，格子的位置会被实时影子推移，从而把不同观众的录像串联起来。
scott-snibbe--cause-and-effect.exercise_en: Record a silhouette clip of each classmate, line them up in a row, and let the next person's shadow push the earlier clips along. Twist: turn the order of pushes into a replayable 'domino' timeline.

camille-utterback--untitled-5.description_zh: 一幅投影出来的“活的绘画”：观众的动作留下柔和、相互交叠的绘画笔触，并会根据人停留的时长和移动的速度作出回应。
camille-utterback--untitled-5.idea_en: People's pauses and movements leave growing brushstrokes on the wall.
camille-utterback--untitled-5.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪的身体位置和运动历史驱动生成式笔触系统，笔触随时间累积并逐渐衰减。
camille-utterback--untitled-5.exercise_en: Drive a generative brush with camera motion detection, leaving strokes on the projection that thicken the longer someone stays. Twist: a line connecting two people appears only when they come close to each other.

scott-snibbe--compliant.description_zh: 一块柔软的投影光矩形像橡皮膜一样：观众的影子可以推它、把它压出凹陷，还能追着它在墙上跑。
scott-snibbe--compliant.idea_en: Make the screen behave like a rubber sheet that people's shadows push and squash.
scott-snibbe--compliant.technique_zh: 把摄像头得到的影子剪影作为碰撞边界，用于投影矩形的弹簧网格（软体）模拟。
scott-snibbe--compliant.exercise_en: Build a spring-mesh square in p5.js, use the camera silhouette of a person as a collider to push it, and project the result. Twist: make the square emit a tone that changes pitch with its deformation when squeezed.

rafael-lozano-hemmer--frequency-and-volu.description_zh: 观众投在墙上的影子可以调收音机：影子的位置选择频率，影子的大小决定音量，让看不见的电波变得可以听见，也变得可以争夺。
rafael-lozano-hemmer--frequency-and-volu.idea_en: Tune a radio with your shadow on the wall to hear the city's invisible airwaves.
rafael-lozano-hemmer--frequency-and-volu.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪墙上影子的位置和大小，并把它们映射为一组计算机控制的无线电接收器的频率和音量。
rafael-lozano-hemmer--frequency-and-volu.exercise_en: Use a camera to detect a shadow on the wall, with its horizontal position choosing which audio clip plays and its size setting the volume. Twist: when several shadows overlap, their sounds mix or interfere with each other.

scott-snibbe--deep-walls.description_zh: 墙上投影出十六个小橱柜：有人走进光束时，他的影子会被录下，随后在某个橱柜里永远循环播放，成为一段往昔访客的影子电影。
scott-snibbe--deep-walls.idea_en: Record passing shadows and keep them looping forever in 'shadow cupboards' on the wall.
scott-snibbe--deep-walls.technique_zh: 摄像头以投影为背景分割出观众的剪影，在有人入画时进行录制，并在空间变空后把片段放进网格中的一个格子里循环播放。
scott-snibbe--deep-walls.exercise_en: Use a camera to cut out people's silhouettes, record them as loops a few seconds long, and assemble them into a projected grid. Twist: each cell keeps only one kind of action (such as waving or jumping), with a simple rule deciding which cell a clip goes into.

camille-utterback--liquid-time.description_zh: 观众的移动会把一段预先录制的街景视频打碎：他们离投影屏越近，那一部分画面就越深地滑回过去。
camille-utterback--liquid-time.idea_en: The closer you get to the screen, the further that patch of the picture slips back into the past.
camille-utterback--liquid-time.technique_zh: 摄像头测量每位观众的位置和距离，用类似狭缝扫描的缓冲区为离观众最近的图像区域选取更早的帧。
camille-utterback--liquid-time.exercise_en: Store a video as a frame buffer, detect a person's position with a camera, and show earlier frames in the vertical strip where they stand. Twist: use the phone's proximity sensor or sound volume to control how far back into the past it goes.

scott-snibbe--shadow.description_zh: 一块简单的投影光矩形；观众投下的起初只是普通的影子，但当他们走开后，影子仍在屏幕上移动，片刻之后重复他们刚才的动作。
scott-snibbe--shadow.idea_en: You have left, but your shadow stays behind and repeats what you just did.
scott-snibbe--shadow.technique_zh: 摄像头捕捉观众的影子剪影，当实时影子消失后，系统把延迟的剪影序列重新投射到同一块屏幕上。
scott-snibbe--shadow.exercise_en: Use background differencing on a webcam feed to get a person's shadow, and project it back onto the wall with a 3-second delay. Twist: make the delayed shadow gradually fade and play in reverse.

daniel-rozin--trash-mirror.description_zh: 从街头收集来的不规则垃圾碎片变成了电动像素，它们倾斜转动，映出观众的影像。
daniel-rozin--trash-mirror.idea_en: Make a mirror that reflects you out of scraps of street trash.
daniel-rozin--trash-mirror.technique_zh: 每块不规则的垃圾碎片都装在一个电机上，对应摄像头画面中的一个区域，通过旋转呈现较亮或较暗的一面。
daniel-rozin--trash-mirror.exercise_en: Collect scrap paper from the classroom to make irregular 'pixels', and build a small prototype with a few servos and a camera. Twist: map each scrap to a region matching its real shape in the image.

klaus-obermaier--vivisector.description_zh: 四位舞者完全由投影光来塑造，没有任何舞台灯光，他们的身体在投影下仿佛被切片、溶解和复制。
klaus-obermaier--vivisector.idea_en: Light the dancers only with projection so their bodies get sliced and dissolved by light.
klaus-obermaier--vivisector.technique_zh: 投影仪是唯一的光源（“舞动的光”），经过编排的视频遮罩显现并切分身体的特定部位。
klaus-obermaier--vivisector.exercise_en: Turn off the classroom lights and use only black-and-white projector masks to light parts of a classmate's body. Twist: track the hand with a camera so the spot of light follows it automatically.

rafael-lozano-hemmer--body-movies.description_zh: 数千幅街头肖像被投射到建筑立面上，但只有在路人巨大的影子里才能看见；根据人与地面灯的距离，影子的高度从 2 米到 25 米不等。
rafael-lozano-hemmer--body-movies.idea_en: Your giant shadow is the only window through which strangers' portraits can be seen.
rafael-lozano-hemmer--body-movies.technique_zh: 机械投影仪把肖像投到被明亮地灯冲淡的立面上；摄像头追踪影子区域，当影子与某幅肖像重合时，场景便切换到下一幕。
rafael-lozano-hemmer--body-movies.exercise_en: Have one projector show images while a strong lamp washes the picture out, so the images are visible only inside classmates' shadows. Twist: use a camera to check whether a shadow fully covers a face, and trigger the next image when it does.

camille-utterback--text-rain.description_zh: 参与者看到自己的镜像视频，同时一首诗的彩色字母像雨一样落下；字母会停落在任何深色的东西上，于是人们可以用身体接住、托起并洒落一行行文字。
camille-utterback--text-rain.idea_en: Catch the letters of a poem falling from the sky with your body.
camille-utterback--text-rain.technique_zh: 每个下落的字母都会检查其下方实时摄像头像素的亮度，当像素比阈值更暗时就停止下落，于是身体的剪影就成了一个实体表面。
camille-utterback--text-rain.exercise_en: Make 'letter rain' with a p5.js camera sketch, where each letter stops when it meets a dark pixel. Twist: use a poem you wrote yourself, and play a sound when caught letters line up into a readable word.

daniel-rozin--wooden-mirror.description_zh: 830 块小木片由各自的电机控制倾斜，它们捕捉到的光形成了站在面前之人的实时木质倒影。
daniel-rozin--wooden-mirror.idea_en: Piece together your live mirror image from turning wooden tiles.
daniel-rozin--wooden-mirror.technique_zh: 隐藏摄像头的画面被降采样到木片网格的分辨率，每个像素的亮度决定一个舵机的角度，从而改变木片反射的光量。
daniel-rozin--wooden-mirror.exercise_en: Build a 'mechanical mirror' from an 8x8 grid of servos and card tiles, with angles controlled by a low-resolution camera image. Twist: switch to a material of your choice (buttons, bottle caps) and compare how 'pixel-like' different materials feel.

scott-snibbe--boundary-functions.description_zh: 一台俯投的投影仪在房间里每个站着的人之间画出线条，把地面划分成个人的沃罗诺伊（Voronoi）单元，随着人们移动，这些单元会扩大、缩小、骤然改变。
scott-snibbe--boundary-functions.idea_en: Draw invisible 'personal space' on the floor as Voronoi lines, so the more people there are, the less space each gets.
scott-snibbe--boundary-functions.technique_zh: 俯拍摄像头追踪每个人在地面上的位置，实时计算这些点的沃罗诺伊图，并从上方投射回地面。
scott-snibbe--boundary-functions.exercise_en: Use an overhead camera and projector (or a phone filming from above with p5.js) to track where classmates stand, and compute and project Voronoi boundaries in real time. Twist: color each cell by its area, turning redder as it shrinks.

klaus-obermaier--dave.description_zh: 独舞者的身体本身成了投影屏幕：变形的面孔、衰老过程和不可能的身体扭曲被精确地映射到运动中的表演者身上。
klaus-obermaier--dave.idea_en: Use the dancer's own body as the screen and project impossible transformations onto it.
klaus-obermaier--dave.technique_zh: 预渲染的视频与舞者逐帧编排，使投影落在身体上；依靠的是排练好的时机，而不是追踪。
klaus-obermaier--dave.exercise_en: Have a classmate in white clothes stand in front of the projector, and project pre-cut face or texture videos onto them following a rehearsed rhythm. Twist: add a small spot of light that follows them live via a camera.
